summary: Cleaned up the chat composer: consistent Image and Send buttons, clearer placeholder and helper text, and a readable auto-approve warning aligned with the message input.
instructions: Open Chat to see the updated composer. Type a draft to check the focus styling and send-button states. In Settings, the auto-approve status now appears in an amber panel with a matching Turn off button when enabled; enabling auto-approve allows shell commands without confirmation. Desktop and mobile layout tests passed at 1905, 1024, 390, and 320px, along with Markdown security tests and all 157 Python tests. Draft handling, approval behavior, and automatic version updates are unchanged.
